_comment: Keys are `<guard>::<capability-marker>`, never a bare capability marker on its own --
the marker half (e.g. 'in-process') is prose lifted from `_HARNESS_CAPABILITY_MARKERS`
and the SAME marker string is reused by unrelated guards to describe DIFFERENT things
(guard_head_tail_rewrite's own advisory text calls its python3-subprocess rewrite
'in-process, zero extra forks', which is a distinct, false claim -- see the roster-truth
audit below). Keying by guard+marker together means adding this guard's true claim here
can never make that unrelated guard's claim grade LIVE by prose coincidence.
An id absent from this manifest is reported UNVERIFIABLE, never guessed at -- see

guard_inprocess_search::in-process.note: guard_inprocess_search (coordinator_core/bash_guards/guard_inprocess_search.py) answers a substitutable grep-shaped Bash command inside the already-running PreToolUse(Bash) hook process -- zero additional subprocess forks. Registered ahead of guard_grep_via_bash in dispatch.py's guard_chain. Ground truth: DoE-claude state/audits/2026-07-29-search-capability-roster-truth.md (this is the ONE non-bash search capability that audit confirms genuinely reachable in-process from a main session; Grep/Glob themselves remain unreachable).

guard_inprocess_search::searched in-proc.note: Same underlying capability as guard_inprocess_search::in-process -- both marker strings fire off the identical rendered footer text ('[Searched inside the coordinator hook process...]'); kept as a separate manifest key because `_HARNESS_CAPABILITY_MARKERS` extracts each marker as its own Alternative.

guard_grep_via_bash::in-process.note: guard_grep_via_bash's composed-advisory message (post project-makima commit 6f3ae2467452, T8 fix) correctly names guard_inprocess_search's real in-process answerer as the reason no rewrite target exists for a composed pipeline -- same underlying capability as the guard_inprocess_search:: entries above, not a separate one. Before 6f3ae2467452 this guard's message instead DENIED the capability existed at all ('there is no harness-native (zero-fork) search from this session') -- that false-negative claim is the T8 defect this manifest exists to make mechanically catchable, per docs/plans/2026-07-29-bash-guard-consolidated-execution.md row S0.
